LESSON: HADITH ON FITNESS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on Etiquette of Eating (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub-stran
Topic 2.4: Hadith on Fitness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Fitness. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should one be physically fit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living
2. value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON FITNESS
This lesson teaches Hadith on Fitness for Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on Fitness using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on Fitness above.
2. Explain Hadith on Fitness to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on Fitness.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Fitness with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Fitness important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one be physically fit?
2. What Islamic rules should a Muslim observe while participating in games and sports activities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected hadith on physical fitness to promote healthy living
2. value the importance of physical fitness as means of being dearer to Allah (S.W.T)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
